summary.text: Montserrat Garibay is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 49 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Green Party candidate Arshia Papari in a race with no incumbent.
A former bilingual pre-K teacher and labor leader, she says she is running to ensure every child learns in a fully funded school.

paragraphs.text: Garibay graduated from Anderson High School and earned a bachelor's and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she came to the United States as a young girl, taught bilingual pre-K in Austin ISD for eight years, became vice president of Education Austin, and was the first Latina elected secretary-treasurer of the Texas AFL-CIO.
She also said she served as a deputy assistant secretary in the U.S. Department of Education in the Biden-Harris administration.
Garibay finished first in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary and defeated Kathie Tovo in the May 26 runoff, 62.2% to 37.8%.
She said in the survey that she is also running for fair wages for workers and opportunity for families.
